name: Jaiwanth Karthi
intro: I work on machine learning models and the software around them, from sign language recognition to neural network optimisation.
about: I am pursuing a Dual Degree in Engineering Design at IIT Madras. My work centres on AI and machine learning, with a particular interest in how models become useful, reliable software.

At Sahaay, I develop deep learning models for Gesturize, a sign language recognition project. I also lead NanoCompile, where our team is working on compiler and inference optimisations for trained neural networks.

My experience spans NLP pipelines at Genstrive, full-stack development at HardJunc, and independent projects in conversational AI, graphics, and simulation. Quantitative research is a complementary interest, through my work with WorldQuant BRAIN.
